rule: core/writing.md: plain words, name the thing, give evidence
prompt: Why does tests/test_count.py fail? Explain in a few lines. Don't change any files.

graders.rubric: Pass only if the answer: uses plain, simple words; names the exact file and the faulty expression; says what is wrong and what the fix is; has no filler or corporate words; is at most about 8 lines.
